speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thou hast looked. Come through. I am not standing in a doorway so thou canst find a better line than the one thou hadst this morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am through. The stone has the sheet. I am not going back out for a second reading of it.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The hall is as I left it. Keep it so. I am not lighting a man back into the apples.
